quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard confirms he is officially retired from the NBA

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on the emotional difficulty of transitioning from superstar to role player
quotes.excerpt: It can be difficult when your ego can be bigger than what you're trying to accomplish.
quotes.quote: It was very difficult coming from a place where I was the number one guy as far as shots, getting touches on the floor, getting minutes, starting. To go from that to maybe not playing some games, to basically sometimes being a cheerleader on the bench. It can be difficult when your ego can be bigger than what you're trying to accomplish. And what I was trying to accomplish was to win a championship. So the ego had to be put to the side, and it was a great experience. I feel like I did so much less, but more.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his pre-game visualization routine and superstition
quotes.excerpt: The night before the game, I would literally be playing the game in my head while I'm sleep.
quotes.quote: The night before the game, I would literally be playing the game in my head while I'm sleep. I would wake up drenched in sweat because I could see the game that's about to happen. Usually before the game, I would know if we're going to win or lose just by the energy that I'm feeling when we're warming up, watching the other team. I do stuff like I put my left shoe on first before the game. I used to have to, before every game, I tried to take a dump. That was my little superstitious thing, take a dump before all the games.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard advises players against taking pay cuts to join teams
quotes.excerpt: No, don't do it. Go get all the money that you can.
quotes.quote: No, don't do it. Go get all the money that you can. I'm not saying do it in a bad way, kids, whoever trying to make it, but no, don't do it. I understand the winning part, but at the end of the day, you can't take away from M&Ms. Give me all that 500. You want me to play on your team, but you're asking me to take a pay cut? No, don't do it. Go get all the money that you can.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard clarifies Kobe Bryant was the first to welcome him to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It was Kobe. That was the first welcome to the NBA moment.
quotes.quote: It was Kobe. That was the first welcome to the NBA moment. He dunked on me first. I thought I researched, I thought I was ready, but he dunked on me. It was Kobe.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on his regret regarding his departure from the Orlando Magic
quotes.excerpt: If I could travel back in time, of course, anybody would handle any situation they felt could have been taken as detriment.
quotes.quote: If I could travel back in time, of course, anybody would handle any situation they felt could have been taken as detriment. But I'm looking at a chance to go to Houston where it's less taxes. That was one of the things that got me at the time. Having an opportunity to get coached and trained with Hakeem Olajuwon. The head coach at the time was Kevin McHale. So for me, I'm looking at it from a standpoint of this is a chance for me to maybe grow as a player. So I'm thinking, oh, this is perfect. You know, we got the men, Harden in the pick and roll, that's going to be hard to D. Then now me catching on the block. Jeremy Lin is here, Chandler Parsons is here, we got shooters, we got defenders. I mean, we made it to the Western Conference Finals. So I feel like that was a, but I had opportunity to play with Steph, too. And I'm tripping.

quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard explains why he didn't join the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: The Magic wanted to get Steph and I said no because I didn't know Monte Ellis, Steph Curry was going to be one of the greatest.
quotes.quote: When I was with the Magic, the Magic was about to, they couldn't at the time, I wanted to play with Monte Ellis. And the Magic wanted to get Steph and I said no because I didn't know Monte Ellis, Steph Curry was going to be one of the greatest. The Magic wanted to get Steph and I said no.
